scope: Read-only logged-trajectory controller audit; no GPU inference or physics. Counterfactual keeps recorded observations/actions/accepted history fixed, so it is not a counterfactual closed-loop outcome.

veto_settings.provenance: Live native terminal-veto algorithm through audited simulation adapter; retain explicit historical task height/aperture defaults. Unlike v1 this is not the fd4a032 veto implementation.

gripper.geometry_source: Rounded pad/backing contact hulls and70mm effective custom-pad aperture fitted against measured grasp; nominal bare Robotiqstroke remains85mm. Contact/material parameters are uncalibrated estimates.
